description: Arabic bullet list where one item starts with English. The list is rtl because its first item is Arabic. Items 1 and 2 start with Arabic (rtl); item 3 starts with English, so it is ltr. The reference packages emit no dir on li, so the kit must set dir="auto" on every li, or item 3 inherits the list direction.
markdown:
- عنصر أول with English words
- الخطوة الثانية: deploy على Render
- item three بالعربي بعده

blocks.note: Starts with English, so ltr. The kit must set dir on li; without it the item inherits rtl from the list.
